(825)gser skyems 'bul ba ni/raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/lan gsum/gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/oṃ āḥhūm̐/rig 'ja

tei:div.tei:p: gser skyems 'bul ba ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ lan gsum/ gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rig 'jin rtsa rgyud bla ma dam pa dang*/ bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ khyad par ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams/ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mjod/ ma mgon lcam dral gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas/ dam can rdor legs tshe (826)ring mched lnga dang*/ rdo rje g.yu sgron bstan skyong gshog rgod ma/ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mjod/ phur srung lcam dral lha mo ngan ne ma/ rgyud mgon legs ldan dpal mgon tshogs kyi bdag bdud mgon yab yum dge bsnyen smyo kha sogs/ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mjod/ btsan rgod chen po rdo rje dgra 'joms rtsal/ rol pa rkya bdun 'bar ba spun bdun dang*/ rgyal chen rnam sras gnyan (827)chen sde bzhir bcas/ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mjod/ 'go ba'i lha lnga skyobs pa'i lha rnas dang*/ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras/ bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas pa rnams/ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mjod/ sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang*/ sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha/ gser (828)skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mjod/ mchog gsum ngo bo dpal mgon bla ma dang*/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i lha/ ma mgon gza' rdor tshe ring mched lnga la/ mchod gsol bstod do bsam don lhun grub mjod/ ces pa'ang rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis gsungs la/ kha skong dz+nyā na'i ming gis bgyis pa'o/ dge'o//
